fusions.name: Thunderclap Call
fusions.desc: A single booming report that deals 32 damage and hits harder the further it travels, up to 2 times at maximum range. Its reach is 50% longer. Against a boss or elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Muzzle Pop
fusions.desc: Fires a sharp click of sound that deals 5 damage to the first enemy it meets. Its reach is 40% longer.

fusions.name: Lengthened Bore
fusions.desc: For 12 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 43% further.

fusions.name: Rolling Report
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, a bolt deals 8 damage to the nearest enemy within 7 tiles. Once every 6 seconds.
